verdict.rationale: The changelog describes triggers that fire when emails arrive and can connect to 3,000+ other apps, and a Tasklet integration acts on emails automatically. That is event-driven automation, but it is not a documented webhook subscription. No public API spec was found at any probed path. missing for 10: documented webhook subscription endpoints, event types and payload schemas, delivery/retry and signing semantics, public API docs, independent corroboration.
